title: Super SMP
description: A Java & Bedrock building server with a fantastic community!
body:
Super SMP is a community-focused Java & Bedrock Survival server centered around towns, building, economy, and long-term player progression.

🏘️ Player-Owned Towns
💎 Diamond-Based Economy
🛒 Shop District
🎉 Weekly Events
🔨 Building-Focused Community
⚡ Quality of Life Features
🛡️ No Griefing or Stealing
🌐 Java & Bedrock Crossplay

Whether you're a builder creating massive projects, a trader building an empire, or a casual player looking for a welcoming community, Super SMP offers a relaxed survival experience without pay-to-win mechanics.

Current Feature: ☀️ A Super Summer — our seasonal event packed with special activities, rewards, and community challenges.

Version: 26.1.1
Platform: Java & Bedrock
Age Requirement: 16+

Join a server where your builds, towns, and friendships actually last.
